rows.name: Steakhouse Financial
farmSteps: Set up a fresh wallet, fund it on Base with $10000.00 plus gas ($0.05-0.30 per tx), and connect it to Steakhouse Financial. COST: $0.00 to set up. TIME: 10 min hands-on.
Place the deposit into a curated vault on Steakhouse Financial on Base run by a curator with a public track record, after reading its risk note. COST: $0.17 on Base. TIME: 15 min hands-on.
Move a small slice to a second curator's vault after two weeks and keep both positions open. COST: $0.17 on Base. TIME: 15 min hands-on.
Hold the position for 12 weeks and touch it once a week, spreading activity across days so it reads as a real user. COST: $0.17 for one mid-hold transaction. TIME: 60 min hands-on.
Do not split the farm across many wallets or copy identical transactions: one wallet, organic timing, and no scripted bursts. COST: $0.00. TIME: 0 min hands-on.
At launch, watch for the claim window, check any vesting or lockup first, and sell only part of the claim on day one if you sell at all. COST: $0.17 to claim. TIME: 15 min hands-on.

farmPlan.title: SETUP
farmPlan.text: Open a fresh wallet used only for this farm, fund it on Base with $10000.00 plus gas, and connect it to Steakhouse Financial. A wallet that has never touched another farm keeps the activity clean and easy to explain.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — wallet creation and funding are arranged off-chain before the first on-chain step)

farmPlan.title: VERIFY
farmPlan.text: Check Steakhouse Financial on DefiLlama and on its official site or docs, and match the contract address shown there against the one the app asks you to sign. Never open the app from a link in a DM or a search ad — type the address yourself.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — reading and checking only)

farmPlan.title: FUND
farmPlan.text: Move $10000.00 into the fresh wallet on Base — one withdrawal from an exchange, or one bridge if the funds sit on another chain — and confirm the balance landed before doing anything else.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.17 (one transaction on Base at ~$0.17 each, gas $0.05-0.30 per tx)

farmPlan.title: RISK
farmPlan.text: Read the strategy and risk note for Steakhouse Financial before depositing: what the position holds, what can be lost, and whether withdrawals can pause. If the note is missing or unreadable, stop here and keep the funds in the wallet.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — reading and checking only)

farmPlan.title: CORE
farmPlan.text: Place the deposit into a curated vault on Steakhouse Financial on Base run by a curator with a public track record, after reading its risk note.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.17 (one transaction on Base at ~$0.17 each, gas $0.05-0.30 per tx)

farmPlan.title: DEEPEN
farmPlan.text: Move a small slice to a second curator's vault after two weeks and keep both positions open.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.17 (one transaction on Base at ~$0.17 each, gas $0.05-0.30 per tx)

farmPlan.title: CADENCE
farmPlan.text: Touch the position once a week for 12 weeks: check the balance and the protocol's announcements, and make one real top-up or rebalance transaction halfway through. Weekly check-ins are free reads; only the mid-hold transaction pays gas.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.17 (one transaction on Base at ~$0.17 each, gas $0.05-0.30 per tx)
farmPlan.time: TIME: 60 min hands-on (5 min a week for 12 weeks)

farmPlan.title: WATCH
farmPlan.text: Set the exit rule and keep it: withdraw if Steakhouse Financial TVL prints below $2,285,804,641, which is -17% from today's $2,753,981,495, or at once if withdrawals pause or the team says a snapshot has already been taken.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — monitoring only)
farmPlan.time: TIME: 30 min hands-on (a few minutes a week for 12 weeks)

farmPlan.title: RECORD
farmPlan.text: Keep a ledger of the farm: date, transaction hash, asset, and dollar value for every move, in one place. If a claim ever needs proof of activity, this ledger is the proof.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — writing down what already happened)

farmPlan.title: CLAIM
farmPlan.text: Watch for the claim window on Steakhouse Financial's official channels, check vesting or lockup terms first, and claim in one transaction. If you sell at all, sell only part of the claim on day one — the rest can wait for the price to find its level.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.17 (one transaction on Base at ~$0.17 each, gas $0.05-0.30 per tx)

rows.exitRule: Withdraw if Steakhouse Financial TVL prints below $2,285,804,641, which is -17% from today's $2,753,981,495. Also pull out at once if withdrawals pause, the team announces a snapshot has already been taken, or the claim window opens and the position no longer needs to sit there.

Swap a modest amount through FstSwap on Binance, then place the same pair into a liquidity position so it starts earning trading fees. COST: $0.40 on Binance. TIME: 15 min hands-on.
After two weeks, take half the liquidity back out, swap the proceeds through FstSwap again, and open a new position at a different size. COST: $0.20 on Binance. TIME: 15 min hands-on.
Hold the position for 12 weeks and touch it once a week, spreading activity across days so it reads as a real user. COST: $0.20 for one mid-hold transaction. TIME: 60 min hands-on.
Do not split the farm across many wallets or copy identical transactions: one wallet, organic timing, and no scripted bursts. COST: $0.00. TIME: 0 min hands-on.
At launch, watch for the claim window, check any vesting or lockup first, and sell only part of the claim on day one if you sell at all. COST: $0.20 to claim. TIME: 15 min hands-on.

farmPlan.title: SETUP
farmPlan.text: Open a fresh wallet used only for this farm, fund it on Binance with $2350.30 plus gas, and connect it to FstSwap. A wallet that has never touched another farm keeps the activity clean and easy to explain.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — wallet creation and funding are arranged off-chain before the first on-chain step)

farmPlan.title: VERIFY
farmPlan.text: Check FstSwap on DefiLlama and on its official site or docs, and match the contract address shown there against the one the app asks you to sign. Never open the app from a link in a DM or a search ad — type the address yourself.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — reading and checking only)

farmPlan.title: FUND
farmPlan.text: Move $2350.30 into the fresh wallet on Binance — one withdrawal from an exchange, or one bridge if the funds sit on another chain — and confirm the balance landed before doing anything else.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.20 (one transaction on Binance at ~$0.20 each, gas $0.10-0.30 per tx)

farmPlan.title: RISK
farmPlan.text: Read the strategy and risk note for FstSwap before depositing: what the position holds, what can be lost, and whether withdrawals can pause. If the note is missing or unreadable, stop here and keep the funds in the wallet.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — reading and checking only)

farmPlan.title: CORE
farmPlan.text: Swap a modest amount through FstSwap on Binance, then place the same pair into a liquidity position so it starts earning trading fees.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.40 (2 transactions on Binance at ~$0.20 each, gas $0.10-0.30 per tx)

farmPlan.title: DEEPEN
farmPlan.text: After two weeks, take half the liquidity back out, swap the proceeds through FstSwap again, and open a new position at a different size.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.20 (one transaction on Binance at ~$0.20 each, gas $0.10-0.30 per tx)

farmPlan.title: CADENCE
farmPlan.text: Touch the position once a week for 12 weeks: check the balance and the protocol's announcements, and make one real top-up or rebalance transaction halfway through. Weekly check-ins are free reads; only the mid-hold transaction pays gas.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.20 (one transaction on Binance at ~$0.20 each, gas $0.10-0.30 per tx)
farmPlan.time: TIME: 60 min hands-on (5 min a week for 12 weeks)

farmPlan.title: WATCH
farmPlan.text: Set the exit rule and keep it: withdraw if FstSwap TVL prints below $9,753,758, which is -17% from today's $11,751,516, or at once if withdrawals pause or the team says a snapshot has already been taken.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — monitoring only)
farmPlan.time: TIME: 30 min hands-on (a few minutes a week for 12 weeks)

farmPlan.title: RECORD
farmPlan.text: Keep a ledger of the farm: date, transaction hash, asset, and dollar value for every move, in one place. If a claim ever needs proof of activity, this ledger is the proof.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — writing down what already happened)

farmPlan.title: CLAIM
farmPlan.text: Watch for the claim window on FstSwap's official channels, check vesting or lockup terms first, and claim in one transaction. If you sell at all, sell only part of the claim on day one — the rest can wait for the price to find its level.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.20 (one transaction on Binance at ~$0.20 each, gas $0.10-0.30 per tx)

rows.exitRule: Withdraw if FstSwap TVL prints below $9,753,758, which is -17% from today's $11,751,516. Also pull out at once if withdrawals pause, the team announces a snapshot has already been taken, or the claim window opens and the position no longer needs to sit there.

Place the deposit into the biggest vault on GrowiHF on Hyperliquid L1 and leave it compounding untouched for at least two weeks. COST: $0.17 on Hyperliquid L1. TIME: 15 min hands-on.
Harvest the yield once, put the harvest straight back into the same vault, and keep the position open for the rest of the hold. COST: $0.17 on Hyperliquid L1. TIME: 15 min hands-on.
Hold the position for 12 weeks and touch it once a week, spreading activity across days so it reads as a real user. COST: $0.17 for one mid-hold transaction. TIME: 60 min hands-on.
Do not split the farm across many wallets or copy identical transactions: one wallet, organic timing, and no scripted bursts. COST: $0.00. TIME: 0 min hands-on.
At launch, watch for the claim window, check any vesting or lockup first, and sell only part of the claim on day one if you sell at all. COST: $0.17 to claim. TIME: 15 min hands-on.

farmPlan.title: SETUP
farmPlan.text: Open a fresh wallet used only for this farm, fund it on Hyperliquid L1 with $2563.69 plus gas, and connect it to GrowiHF. A wallet that has never touched another farm keeps the activity clean and easy to explain.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — wallet creation and funding are arranged off-chain before the first on-chain step)

farmPlan.title: VERIFY
farmPlan.text: Check GrowiHF on DefiLlama and on its official site or docs, and match the contract address shown there against the one the app asks you to sign. Never open the app from a link in a DM or a search ad — type the address yourself.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — reading and checking only)

farmPlan.title: FUND
farmPlan.text: Move $2563.69 into the fresh wallet on Hyperliquid L1 — one withdrawal from an exchange, or one bridge if the funds sit on another chain — and confirm the balance landed before doing anything else.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.17 (one transaction on Hyperliquid L1 at ~$0.17 each, gas $0.05-0.30 per tx)

farmPlan.title: RISK
farmPlan.text: Read the strategy and risk note for GrowiHF before depositing: what the position holds, what can be lost, and whether withdrawals can pause. If the note is missing or unreadable, stop here and keep the funds in the wallet.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — reading and checking only)

farmPlan.title: CORE
farmPlan.text: Place the deposit into the biggest vault on GrowiHF on Hyperliquid L1 and leave it compounding untouched for at least two weeks.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.17 (one transaction on Hyperliquid L1 at ~$0.17 each, gas $0.05-0.30 per tx)

farmPlan.title: DEEPEN
farmPlan.text: Harvest the yield once, put the harvest straight back into the same vault, and keep the position open for the rest of the hold.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.17 (one transaction on Hyperliquid L1 at ~$0.17 each, gas $0.05-0.30 per tx)

farmPlan.title: CADENCE
farmPlan.text: Touch the position once a week for 12 weeks: check the balance and the protocol's announcements, and make one real top-up or rebalance transaction halfway through. Weekly check-ins are free reads; only the mid-hold transaction pays gas.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.17 (one transaction on Hyperliquid L1 at ~$0.17 each, gas $0.05-0.30 per tx)
farmPlan.time: TIME: 60 min hands-on (5 min a week for 12 weeks)

farmPlan.title: WATCH
farmPlan.text: Set the exit rule and keep it: withdraw if GrowiHF TVL prints below $10,639,316, which is -17% from today's $12,818,453, or at once if withdrawals pause or the team says a snapshot has already been taken.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — monitoring only)
farmPlan.time: TIME: 30 min hands-on (a few minutes a week for 12 weeks)

farmPlan.title: RECORD
farmPlan.text: Keep a ledger of the farm: date, transaction hash, asset, and dollar value for every move, in one place. If a claim ever needs proof of activity, this ledger is the proof.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — writing down what already happened)

farmPlan.title: CLAIM
farmPlan.text: Watch for the claim window on GrowiHF's official channels, check vesting or lockup terms first, and claim in one transaction. If you sell at all, sell only part of the claim on day one — the rest can wait for the price to find its level.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.17 (one transaction on Hyperliquid L1 at ~$0.17 each, gas $0.05-0.30 per tx)

rows.exitRule: Withdraw if GrowiHF TVL prints below $10,639,316, which is -17% from today's $12,818,453. Also pull out at once if withdrawals pause, the team announces a snapshot has already been taken, or the claim window opens and the position no longer needs to sit there.

Swap a modest amount through Tempo Stablecoin Dex on Tempo, then place the same pair into a liquidity position so it starts earning trading fees. COST: $2.50 on Tempo. TIME: 15 min hands-on.
After two weeks, take half the liquidity back out, swap the proceeds through Tempo Stablecoin Dex again, and open a new position at a different size. COST: $1.25 on Tempo. TIME: 15 min hands-on.
Hold the position for 12 weeks and touch it once a week, spreading activity across days so it reads as a real user. COST: $1.25 for one mid-hold transaction. TIME: 60 min hands-on.
Do not split the farm across many wallets or copy identical transactions: one wallet, organic timing, and no scripted bursts. COST: $0.00. TIME: 0 min hands-on.
At launch, watch for the claim window, check any vesting or lockup first, and sell only part of the claim on day one if you sell at all. COST: $1.25 to claim. TIME: 15 min hands-on.

farmPlan.title: SETUP
farmPlan.text: Open a fresh wallet used only for this farm, fund it on Tempo with $3408.74 plus gas, and connect it to Tempo Stablecoin Dex. A wallet that has never touched another farm keeps the activity clean and easy to explain.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — wallet creation and funding are arranged off-chain before the first on-chain step)

farmPlan.title: VERIFY
farmPlan.text: Check Tempo Stablecoin Dex on DefiLlama and on its official site or docs, and match the contract address shown there against the one the app asks you to sign. Never open the app from a link in a DM or a search ad — type the address yourself.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — reading and checking only)

farmPlan.title: FUND
farmPlan.text: Move $3408.74 into the fresh wallet on Tempo — one withdrawal from an exchange, or one bridge if the funds sit on another chain — and confirm the balance landed before doing anything else.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $1.25 (one transaction on Tempo at ~$1.25 each, gas $0.50-2 per tx)

farmPlan.title: RISK
farmPlan.text: Read the strategy and risk note for Tempo Stablecoin Dex before depositing: what the position holds, what can be lost, and whether withdrawals can pause. If the note is missing or unreadable, stop here and keep the funds in the wallet.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — reading and checking only)

farmPlan.title: CORE
farmPlan.text: Swap a modest amount through Tempo Stablecoin Dex on Tempo, then place the same pair into a liquidity position so it starts earning trading fees.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $2.50 (2 transactions on Tempo at ~$1.25 each, gas $0.50-2 per tx)

farmPlan.title: DEEPEN
farmPlan.text: After two weeks, take half the liquidity back out, swap the proceeds through Tempo Stablecoin Dex again, and open a new position at a different size.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $1.25 (one transaction on Tempo at ~$1.25 each, gas $0.50-2 per tx)

farmPlan.title: CADENCE
farmPlan.text: Touch the position once a week for 12 weeks: check the balance and the protocol's announcements, and make one real top-up or rebalance transaction halfway through. Weekly check-ins are free reads; only the mid-hold transaction pays gas.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $1.25 (one transaction on Tempo at ~$1.25 each, gas $0.50-2 per tx)
farmPlan.time: TIME: 60 min hands-on (5 min a week for 12 weeks)

farmPlan.title: WATCH
farmPlan.text: Set the exit rule and keep it: withdraw if Tempo Stablecoin Dex TVL prints below $14,146,282, which is -17% from today's $17,043,713, or at once if withdrawals pause or the team says a snapshot has already been taken.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — monitoring only)
farmPlan.time: TIME: 30 min hands-on (a few minutes a week for 12 weeks)

farmPlan.title: RECORD
farmPlan.text: Keep a ledger of the farm: date, transaction hash, asset, and dollar value for every move, in one place. If a claim ever needs proof of activity, this ledger is the proof.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — writing down what already happened)

farmPlan.title: CLAIM
farmPlan.text: Watch for the claim window on Tempo Stablecoin Dex's official channels, check vesting or lockup terms first, and claim in one transaction. If you sell at all, sell only part of the claim on day one — the rest can wait for the price to find its level.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $1.25 (one transaction on Tempo at ~$1.25 each, gas $0.50-2 per tx)

rows.exitRule: Withdraw if Tempo Stablecoin Dex TVL prints below $14,146,282, which is -17% from today's $17,043,713. Also pull out at once if withdrawals pause, the team announces a snapshot has already been taken, or the claim window opens and the position no longer needs to sit there.

farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — wallet creation and funding are arranged off-chain before the first on-chain step)

farmPlan.title: VERIFY
farmPlan.text: Check Swan DAO on DefiLlama and on its official site or docs, and match the contract address shown there against the one the app asks you to sign. Never open the app from a link in a DM or a search ad — type the address yourself.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — reading and checking only)

farmPlan.title: FUND
farmPlan.text: Move $1228.41 into the fresh wallet on Ethereum — one withdrawal from an exchange, or one bridge if the funds sit on another chain — and confirm the balance landed before doing anything else.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $11.50 (one transaction on Ethereum at ~$11.50 each, gas $8-15 per tx)

farmPlan.title: RISK
farmPlan.text: Read the strategy and risk note for Swan DAO before depositing: what the position holds, what can be lost, and whether withdrawals can pause. If the note is missing or unreadable, stop here and keep the funds in the wallet.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — reading and checking only)

farmPlan.title: CORE
farmPlan.text: Lock collateral in Swan DAO on Ethereum and mint its stablecoin against it at less than half the collateral's value.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $23.00 (2 transactions on Ethereum at ~$11.50 each, gas $8-15 per tx)

farmPlan.title: DEEPEN
farmPlan.text: Spend the minted stablecoin somewhere low-risk, buy it back, and close the vault before the hold period ends.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $11.50 (one transaction on Ethereum at ~$11.50 each, gas $8-15 per tx)

farmPlan.title: CADENCE
farmPlan.text: Touch the position once a week for 12 weeks: check the balance and the protocol's announcements, and make one real top-up or rebalance transaction halfway through. Weekly check-ins are free reads; only the mid-hold transaction pays gas.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $11.50 (one transaction on Ethereum at ~$11.50 each, gas $8-15 per tx)
farmPlan.time: TIME: 60 min hands-on (5 min a week for 12 weeks)

farmPlan.title: WATCH
farmPlan.text: Set the exit rule and keep it: withdraw if Swan DAO TVL prints below $5,097,920, which is -17% from today's $6,142,072, or at once if withdrawals pause or the team says a snapshot has already been taken.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — monitoring only)
farmPlan.time: TIME: 30 min hands-on (a few minutes a week for 12 weeks)

farmPlan.title: RECORD
farmPlan.text: Keep a ledger of the farm: date, transaction hash, asset, and dollar value for every move, in one place. If a claim ever needs proof of activity, this ledger is the proof.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $0.00 (no transaction — writing down what already happened)

farmPlan.title: CLAIM
farmPlan.text: Watch for the claim window on Swan DAO's official channels, check vesting or lockup terms first, and claim in one transaction. If you sell at all, sell only part of the claim on day one — the rest can wait for the price to find its level.
farmPlan.cost: COST: $11.50 (one transaction on Ethereum at ~$11.50 each, gas $8-15 per tx)

rows.exitRule: Withdraw if Swan DAO TVL prints below $5,097,920, which is -17% from today's $6,142,072. Also pull out at once if withdrawals pause, the team announces a snapshot has already been taken, or the claim window opens and the position no longer needs to sit there.

range.note: Intervals are the implied value shifted by the quantiles of the value model's own held-out log residuals (LOO residuals for the board bounds). Coverage is the share of priced protocols whose real cap fell inside the interval: LOO over all priced rows, walk-forward over the dated rows with a walk-forward prediction.

groups.label: Ranked — early, pre-token, below the $50M floor
Ranked — pre-token, off the watchlist and above the floor
Priced token — trades, used as a comparable
Token recorded, but no usable market cap
Out — versioned/wrapped variant, or unranked pre-token with no recorded token
